steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish package structure, metadata configuration, and API schema.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Set up Gradle build settings, dependencies, and compilation targets for Java 8 and Android 34.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Declare application activities, internet connectivity, and external read permissions.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Layer
steps.description: Create SQLite database helper and product model for offline storage of product catalog.

steps.title: Implement TrumpleDroid Backend Authentication Client
steps.description: Construct HTTP networking client for user authentication, registration, OTP request, and password reset.

steps.title: Implement Image Worker Client and Compression Utility
steps.description: Build multipart image uploader, retrieval handler, deletion coordinator, and 200 KB image compressor.

steps.title: Design Application UI Layouts
steps.description: Build Material XML layouts for Login, Main catalog list, Product Card item, and Add/Edit product screens.

steps.title: Implement Authentication Activities
steps.description: Build LoginActivity handling sign-in, account creation, and OTP password recovery workflows.

steps.title: Implement Product Add and Edit Activity
steps.description: Handle image selection from gallery, validation, resizing under 200 KB, multipart upload, and SQLite persistence.

steps.title: Implement Main Product Catalog Activity
steps.description: Render offline SQLite products, asynchronously fetch private images from Image Worker, calculate inventory value, and handle deletion.

steps.title: Building Product Image Manager
steps.description: Compile and package the complete Android native project.
